case_name.description: label of a case; not identity (benchmark_id is derived)

attr.description: registry key; <name> marks a variable segment

attr_glob.description: attribute key or glob over registry keys

tags.description: hashed into benchmark_id unless in a run-context namespace (platform__, testtype__, cadence__)

extensions.description: pack prefix -> block validated by that pack's extension schema for this kind

valref.description: a value or the name of an environment variable; never a secret

predicate.description: structured filter predicate: {field, one op}, or {any: [...]}, or {not: {...}}

select.description: pure function of (asset contents, select); every random operation carries a seed

subset.description: named subset of the Dataset; inline select fields override it

input.description: exactly one of dataset, asset, model

load.description: closed {concurrency, requests|duration}; open {rate, requests|duration}; batch {requests}; iterations {iterations}; ramp {stages}

slo.description: metric name -> bound; hashed in base units

workload_inline.description: a named Workload extended with `patch`, or a typed inline spec

run.description: run attributes: never identity; overridable at run time

profile.description: profile level is a run attribute: same benchmark_id at every level

patch.description: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) over the Benchmark spec

range.description: numeric sweep; step N adds, step xK multiplies

selector.description: AND of the given terms; groupings select on any Project grouping (at_most/at_least need an ordered one)

asset_source.description: exactly one of store+path, uri, generator

groupings.description: stored as run props run.<name> / run.<name>.<value>; never tags

series_labels.description: baseline/series key = hash of these label values + benchmark_id

spec.description: a catalog root (one per repo or central config tree)
a folder of Benchmarks and its policy; the folder is the primary run.suite.<name>

subject.description: pin the subject, e.g. a pinned reference artifact

spec.description: named set: explicit case names or a selector (exactly one), plus reuse and run defaults

type.description: test type: perf | quality (+ pack vocabularies)

previous_names.description: names this Benchmark had; links history, ids still change

spec.description: a TEMPLATE: exactly one of variants, matrix, derive expands it into cases; a case id is its benchmark_id
configuration under test; typed. `backend` and `extensions` are unhashed (the comparison axis)
load put on a System: inputs (Asset layer), load executor, SLO; typed. Names no hardware
physical data: shape, source, integrity, access; asset_id is content-addressed
semantics over assets (role, schema, named subsets); `asset` is shorthand for one
semantics over weight assets; model_id = hash of the (role, asset_id) set
how to reach data: references to credentials, never values

clean.description: clean run on demand via exclusive access to the node; absent means ordinary CI

labels.description: declared coarse facts, stored as env.label.<key>

policy.description: may only tighten the purpose floor

spec.description: the REQUEST: what a case needs. Never identity, never says where or how to launch

qualification.description: reference grade needs a passing probe at most expiry_days old; results never expire

spec.description: a class of hosts, their expected profile and qualification policy

floor.description: lowest validity a result may have to be used for this purpose; an Environment may only tighten it

clean.description: enforced = run.clean.exclusive enforced; clean = enforced, or observed + load_clean + devices_exclusive enforced

requires.description: gates a result must pass to earn `valid`; failing one caps the validity (qualification: unqualified_env, clean: shared_env, the rest: suspect)

baseline.description: valid results of this purpose may serve as baselines

reference.description: valid results of this purpose earn reference grade (never external)

spec.description: central: per purpose, the gates for each validity and the floor; external uploads never earn reference grade

selector.description: which cases this judges; AND of the given terms

baseline.description: rolling: the last `window` prior VALID runs of these purposes in the same series; fixed: a target in base units

tolerance.description: worse-than-baseline tolerance (floor_pct); direction comes from the Metric

noise.description: the effective floor is never tighter than this noise estimate

severity.description: default advisory; gating fails the verdict

spec.description: authored next to the benchmark: how to judge one metric. Verdicts: pass | regressed | improved | suspected | no_baseline
a query over stored results, not a run: unlisted keys are held; unknown attributes are never held

load.description: executors the workload type accepts; empty = no load block

refs.description: typed field -> kind; identity uses the referenced id, not the name

resolvers.description: turn a build reference into subject.id and subject.dep.* attributes

spec.description: registers a pack: types, extensions, vocabularies, attribute registry, device classes, metrics, runners, probes, analyzers, resolvers
